items.content_html: This repository contains a food stall ordering website for a short college event. Students scan a QR code, browse the menu, add items to their cart, submit an order, pay using your UPI QR, and receive an order token. Stall staff open a lightweight admin dashboard to verify UPI payments and move orders through the queue.

items.content_html: Purpose Chore Champions is a lightweight, kid-friendly chore tracking MVP.
